news.headline: Tropical Storm Edouard nears Gulf Coast
news.body: Tropical Storm Edouard strengthened over the Gulf and was forecast to approach the Texas-Louisiana coast, raising flood and wind concerns. Authorities issued warnings and emergency services prepared evacuations ahead of expected heavy rain and possible storm surge.
